slides.title: What is a Process ?
slides.body:
What is a Process?
One key concept of success in organizing and improve the operational efficiency of a business is the
People, Process, Tools framework:
A Process is a series of steps and actions taken in order
to produce a particular «goal».
It articulates the «How» aspect of an organization
It is important that People have clear roles in the Process,
and that they fully understand it
The Tools can improve the Process

slides.title: An example of a running V - cycle process
slides.body:
An example of a running V-cycle process
The Airbag system is a critical module of a vehicle: it has to
deploy flawlessly in case of a major accident, it doesn’t have to
deploy when not required, and its malfunction shall be promptly
and properly notified to the final user.
The candidate module to show the Airbag Malfunction signal is the
IPC (Instrument Panel Cluster).
Functional Safety analysis suggests that the mechanism providing
the malfunction information shall be reliable and fail-proof to a
certain degree.
Homologation constraints allows the usage of a standard icon,
which can be orange or red. Red has been chosen.

slides.body:
An example of a running V-cycle process
ACU shall be capable of diagnostic check on the functionality (sensors,
actuators, SW, HW, Communication).
It shall foresee a dedicated signal on communication Bus for malfunction,
and shall manage a dedicated hardwired signal accordingly to system
status.
IPC shall manage signal on comm Bus and hardwired signal coherently
with ACU, and shall foresee a dedicated red lamp and a serigraph on the
panel. The lamp shall be turned on upon malfunction signal receiving.
Infotainment and Chassis Domain Controllers shall manage the transfer
of malfunction signal.

Output: ECUs I/O and
HW/SW specs,
